stem: A business first paid for Business Care in February 2026, cancelled in April and came back in July. An analyst's query puts it in both the February cohort and a July cohort. What is the right treatment?

options.text: It stays in the February cohort only; July's cohort is overstated
Nothing changes: a business starts a new cohort each time it returns
It moves to the July cohort and leaves the February cohort
It is dropped from both cohorts, because its history has a gap
